meaning: Operational configuration adapter of existing all_external_causes_impossible: population and full causal well-foundedness at one world contradict the all-world claim that every existent has a distinct existing cause. It uses no explanation-coverage or PSR premise and is not a new philosophical discovery. Existing EmptyWorld, MutualCauses and Intrinsic controls provide the three single-removal interpretations; no new model data are introduced. Root premises unchanged.
